message:
Command `python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Create a candidate that attempts to force the parser to treat extra bytes as part of the PROXY frame.
sig=bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# Use TCP4 with exact 12-byte address block and append a second HTTP-like line.
data = sig + bytes([0x21,0x11]) + (12).to_bytes(2,'big') + bytes.fromhex('7f0000017f00000130390050') + b'GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: y\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_http_tail.bin').write_bytes(data)
# Trace focusing on advancement and subsequent request parsing.
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The harness turns on proxy parsing for every candidate input."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The input includes a complete HTTP request tail so the finalizer lets it proceed."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The parser dispatches into PROXY v2 handling before HTTP parsing starts."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are interpreted as a PROXY v2 header."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":236,"var":"hdr->fam","code":"if (hdr->fam == TCP4) { ... } else if (hdr->fam == TCP6) { ... }","note":"The TCP4 branch writes source and destination addresses directly into the request proxy state."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":254,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","note":"The parser advances exactly past the declared PROXY frame length, so any extra bytes are treated as the next protocol layer."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1176,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"HTTP parsing resumes on the attacker-supplied tail, which is where a length miscalculation would surface."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_http_tail.bin')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
